verified_facts: OS Terrain50 grid uses regular 50m post spacing
Terrain50 is supplied as 10km by 10km tiles
tiles are identified by National Grid reference of south-west corner
grid is available in ASCII grid format
Terrain50 grid has been verified to 4m RMSE
product is maintained through a 3-to-5-year flying programme
Terrain50 uses same source family used to update OS large-scale products
50m spacing is coarser than EA 1m DTM
4m RMSE is not suitable as parcel-height precision
Terrain50 should serve as broad independent corroboration rather than primary parcel elevation
quality_effect: Pins Terrain50 tile/grid semantics and prevents its broad 4m RMSE from being promoted to parcel-scale elevation precision.
